From c132fe78ad7b4ce8b5d49a501a15c29d08eeb23a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Miaoqian Lin <linmq006@gmail.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jun 2022 08:27:23 +0400
Subject: [PATCH] dmaengine: ti: Fix refcount leak in
 ti_dra7_xbar_route_allocate

of_parse_phandle() returns a node pointer with refcount
incremented, we should use of_node_put() on it when not needed anymore.

Add missing of_node_put() in to fix this.

Fixes: ec9bfa1e1a79 ("dmaengine: ti-dma-crossbar: dra7: Use bitops instead of idr")
Signed-off-by: Miaoqian Lin <linmq006@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220605042723.17668-2-linmq006@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Vinod Koul <vkoul@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/dma/ti/dma-crossbar.c b/drivers/dma/ti/dma-crossbar.c
index 71d24fc07c00..e34cfb50d241 100644
--- a/drivers/dma/ti/dma-crossbar.c
+++ b/drivers/dma/ti/dma-crossbar.c
@@ -268,6 +268,7 @@ static void *ti_dra7_xbar_route_allocate(struct of_phandle_args *dma_spec,
 		mutex_unlock(&xbar->mutex);
 		dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Run out of free DMA requests\n");
 		kfree(map);
+		of_node_put(dma_spec->np);
 		return ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);
 	}
 	set_bit(map->xbar_out, xbar->dma_inuse);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/dma/ti/dma-crossbar.c`**
- Added a call to `of_node_put(dma_spec->np);` before returning an error pointer (`ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);`) in the `ti_dra7_xbar_route_allocate` function. This change addresses a reference count leak by ensuring that the node pointer obtained from `of_parse_phandle()` is properly released when it is no longer needed.

### Relationships
The modification in `drivers/dma/ti/dma-crossbar.c` is directly related to the bug fix for a reference count leak that occurs when the function `of_parse_phandle()` is called. The added `of_node_put()` call ensures that the reference count is decremented appropriately, preventing potential memory leaks. This change is a corrective measure for the issue introduced in a previous commit identified by the hash `ec9bfa1e1a79`, which altered the handling of DMA requests in the TI DMA crossbar driver.

        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug is caused by a failure to release the reference count on a node pointer obtained from `of_parse_phandle()`. When this function is called, it increments the reference count of the node, and if the node is not released using `of_node_put()` when it is no longer needed, it leads to a memory leak. In the case of an error (like running out of DMA requests), the function was returning without decrementing the reference count, resulting in a leak.
